text.arabic_uthmani: قَالَ بَلْ سَوَّلَتْ لَكُمْ أَنفُسُكُمْ أَمْرًۭا ۖ فَصَبْرٌۭ جَمِيلٌ ۖ عَسَى ٱللَّهُ أَن يَأْتِيَنِى بِهِمْ جَمِيعًا ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْعَلِيمُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ

words.gloss_range: completed speech introducing Jacob’s corrective direct reply
words.root_gloss_range: saying, speech, and reported utterance; locally the completed speech verb opens a counter-diagnosis rather than a neutral report
words.prose: {{ar:قَالَ}} ({{tr:qāla}}) opens Jacob’s direct speech as a completed stance, and {{ar:ق و ل}} ({{tr:q-w-l}}) keeps the speech-act frame visible. The 3ms verb does not rename Jacob, so his authority is carried by the discourse frame while the reply moves straight into correction. The word does not merely report that he spoke; it launches a corrective reply whose internal movement runs from diagnosis to restraint, hope, and a theological seal, repeating the crisis-response frame of 12:18 inside the speech chain of 12:80-96.

topics.headline: integrated lexical and structural payoff
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah opens as a settled counter-speech that reprises Jacob’s earlier crisis formula from 12:18.

words.gloss_range: corrective particle canceling the prior claim and replacing it with Jacob’s diagnosis
words.prose: {{ar:بَلْ}} ({{tr:bal}}) is the hinge of correction. It cancels the brothers’ prior self-presentation and makes the following diagnosis the replacement account rather than an added complaint. Its separate particle shape gives the cancellation its own boundary before the soul-enticing clause begins.

topics.headline: integrated lexical and structural payoff
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that Jacob first overturns the prior claim before giving his replacement diagnosis.

words.gloss_range: Form II perfect: the selves have already made an affair seem fair to the brothers
words.root_gloss_range: self-prompting, making a matter seem fair, and desire-shaped embellishment; locally Form II selects inward moral rationalization, not external decoration
words.prose: {{ar:سَوَّلَتْ}} ({{tr:sawwalat}}) names the completed inner mechanism: the brothers’ own selves have already made an affair seem acceptable. Its feminine singular agreement points to the plural selves as active subject, not a passive container of blame. Its {{ar:س و ل}} ({{tr:s-w-l}}) pressure, Form II shape, rare moral distribution, and exact recurrence from 12:18 make Jacob’s accusation a specialized diagnosis of self-embellishment rather than external decoration.

topics.headline: integrated lexical and structural payoff
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the accusation is a specialized inward mechanism of self-made fair-seeming, not generic beautification.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows for this word converge on the local grammar, lexical range, structural position, and concrete inter-ayah references preserved in the prose.

words.gloss_range: preposition plus second-person plural suffix routing the embellished affair to the addressed brothers
words.prose: {{ar:لَكُمْ}} ({{tr:lakum}}) attaches the diagnosis directly to the addressed group. The fused preposition and plural suffix route the self-made affair toward them before the inner agent is named, holding together the way it seemed useful to them and the way it is exposed as morally damaging to them.

topics.headline: integrated lexical and structural payoff
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the brothers are addressed as recipients of their own self-embellishment, with seeming benefit exposed as harm.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows for this word converge on the local grammar, lexical range, structural position, and concrete inter-ayah references preserved in the prose.

words.gloss_range: possessed plural selves acting as the grammatical and moral agent of the embellishment
words.root_gloss_range: self, soul, interior life, desire, and moral agency; locally the possessed plural selves become the inner agent of distortion
words.prose: {{ar:أَنفُسُكُمْ}} ({{tr:anfusukum}}) makes the accusation inward and distributed. The plural possessed noun serves as the nominative agent while licensing the feminine singular verb, so a group of selves acts as one grammatical source. The {{ar:ن ف س}} ({{tr:n-f-s}}) range supplies self, desire, and moral interiority, while the plural suffix ties that agency directly to the brothers and joins a Surah Yusuf self-field that includes 12:23, 12:51, 12:53, and 12:77.

topics.headline: integrated lexical and structural payoff
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that agency is placed inside the brothers’ possessed plural selves and tied to the surah’s wider moral psychology.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows for this word converge on the local grammar, lexical range, structural position, and concrete inter-ayah references preserved in the prose.

words.gloss_range: indefinite accusative object: an unnamed affair or course of action made acceptable by the selves
words.root_gloss_range: matter, affair, command, concern, and course of action; locally narrowed to the unnamed affair worked upon by self-embellishment, with command-pressure as background
words.prose: {{ar:أَمْرًا}} ({{tr:amran}}) is the accusative object of the embellishment, but its indefiniteness keeps the affair unnamed. As a verbal noun, the word can hold event, matter, and command pressure together. The {{ar:أ م ر}} ({{tr:ʾ-m-r}}) range lets matter, command, and course-of-action pressure remain audible, while local syntax makes it the morally suspect affair the selves worked on and contrasts it with rightly governed command language in 12:21, 12:40, and 12:68.

topics.headline: integrated lexical and structural payoff
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that Jacob leaves the affair unnamed while preserving the pressure of matter, command, and course of action.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows for this word converge on the local grammar, lexical range, structural position, and concrete inter-ayah references preserved in the prose.

words.gloss_range: consecutive connector binding the diagnosis to the patience response
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) makes the patience phrase a consequence and next speech beat. As a proclitic joined to the patience noun, it makes the response feel immediately generated by the diagnosis. It keeps accusation and restraint connected while preventing the patience clause from becoming another object of the preceding verb.

topics.headline: integrated lexical and structural payoff
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that Jacob moves directly from diagnosis into disciplined restraint.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows for this word converge on the local grammar, lexical range, structural position, and concrete inter-ayah references preserved in the prose.

words.gloss_range: indefinite nominative verbal noun forming an elliptical prescription of active restraint
words.root_gloss_range: patience, endurance, restraint, and holding oneself back; locally a compact nominal response after accusation
words.prose: {{ar:صَبْرٌ}} ({{tr:ṣabrun}}) turns grief into a terse nominal prescription. The recoverable frame is omitted, leaving the noun itself to carry the response as a state to inhabit rather than a narrated action. The {{ar:ص ب ر}} ({{tr:ṣ-b-r}}) range makes patience active self-restraint, and the verbless form performs that restraint while repeating the 12:18 crisis formula and anticipating the patience-reward movement of 12:90.

topics.headline: integrated lexical and structural payoff
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that patience is enacted as terse active restraint and not merely described as waiting.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows for this word converge on the local grammar, lexical range, structural position, and concrete inter-ayah references preserved in the prose.

words.gloss_range: nominative indefinite adjective making patience ethically beautiful and complete
words.root_gloss_range: beauty, fittingness, grace, and wholeness; locally the quality of Jacob’s restraint, not visual beauty
words.prose: {{ar:جَمِيلٌ}} ({{tr:jamīlun}}) locks the patience noun into an ethical category: restraint that is fitting, whole, and graceful. The {{ar:ج م ل}} ({{tr:j-m-l}}) pressure keeps beauty tied to moral composure rather than visual appearance, and the repeated formula links 12:18 with the broader beautiful-patience category of 70:5.

topics.headline: integrated lexical and structural payoff
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that beauty modifies patience as ethical wholeness and formulaic graceful restraint.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows for this word converge on the local grammar, lexical range, structural position, and concrete inter-ayah references preserved in the prose.

topics.headline: unsupported 25:32 formula claim
topics.blocking_evidence: The cited 25:32 evidence does not contain the claimed patience-beauty formula and the row internally notes the absence.
topics.reason: The row cites 25:32 for the patience-beauty formula, but its own content says the target adjective is absent there, so it cannot support this formula parallel.

words.gloss_range: defective hope verb opening a God-directed expectation after the patience phrase
words.root_gloss_range: hope, possibility, and strained expectation; locally human hope directed to divine agency, not a bare certainty claim
words.prose: {{ar:عَسَى}} ({{tr:ʿasā}}) pivots the ayah from restrained response into hope. The defective verb governs the named divine subject and a dependent content clause, so the hoped event is grammatically built rather than loosely implied. The {{ar:ع س ي}} ({{tr:ʿ-s-y}}) form keeps Jacob’s wording humble and future-facing, while the divine subject and final asserted attributes give that difficult hope its warrant; the added hope clause also distinguishes 12:83 from the shorter 12:18 parallel.

topics.headline: integrated lexical and structural payoff
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the emotional turn from restrained grief into difficult, God-directed hope.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows for this word converge on the local grammar, lexical range, structural position, and concrete inter-ayah references preserved in the prose.

words.gloss_range: proper divine name as the subject and agent of the hoped bringing
words.root_gloss_range: the divine name; locally the named agent of restoration, with derivational debate only enriching the background
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهُ}} ({{tr:Allāhu}}) names the agent before the hoped action is stated. As the nominative subject of the hope verb, it removes the brothers as agents of restoration. The {{ar:أ ل ه}} ({{tr:ʾ-l-h}}) background remains secondary here; the local force is that restoration is shifted from the brothers to God, whose knowledge-wisdom attributes frame promise, crisis, and fulfillment in 12:6, 12:83, and 12:100.

topics.headline: integrated lexical and structural payoff
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that agency for restoration shifts to the named divine subject and then into the closing attribute seal.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows for this word converge on the local grammar, lexical range, structural position, and concrete inter-ayah references preserved in the prose.

words.gloss_range: subordinating particle specifying the content of the hope
words.prose: {{ar:أَن}} ({{tr:an}}) turns the next verb into the content of Jacob’s hope. As a separate complementizer, it makes the dependency visible on the surface before the delivery construction is completed. The particle makes the desired event specific: divine bringing, not general improvement or undefined relief.

topics.headline: integrated lexical and structural payoff
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that Jacob’s hope has a precise grammatical content rather than a vague object.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows for this word converge on the local grammar, lexical range, structural position, and concrete inter-ayah references preserved in the prose.

words.gloss_range: subjunctive bringing verb with first-person endpoint and prepositional delivery construction
words.root_gloss_range: coming, arriving, bringing, and reaching; locally selected as bringing persons to Jacob through the delivery construction
words.prose: {{ar:يَأْتِيَنِي}} ({{tr:yaʾtiyanī}}) gives the hope its motion: God may bring the absent ones to Jacob. Its subjunctive form keeps the event dependent on the hope clause rather than asserted as already happening. The {{ar:أ ت ي}} ({{tr:ʾ-t-y}}) range is narrowed by the delivery construction and first-person suffix, so the event is directed restoration to the speaker, linked to the bringing pattern of 12:66 and the later fulfillment command of 12:93.

topics.headline: integrated lexical and structural payoff
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the hoped event is directed divine delivery to Jacob, not bare arrival.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows for this word converge on the local grammar, lexical range, structural position, and concrete inter-ayah references preserved in the prose.

words.gloss_range: preposition completing the transitive bringing-with construction
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) is the small hinge that turns coming into bringing-with. It governs the following plural suffix as the carried group, holding accompaniment and transitivizing force together. It links the motion verb to the carried group and makes the pronoun part of the delivery construction.

topics.headline: integrated lexical and structural payoff
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the small preposition is what makes the motion verb a bringing-with construction.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows for this word converge on the local grammar, lexical range, structural position, and concrete inter-ayah references preserved in the prose.

words.gloss_range: bound third-person plural pronoun whose scope is expanded by the following totality marker
words.prose: {{ar:هِمْ}} ({{tr:him}}) compresses the absent persons into one plural suffix. The following totality marker then opens that compact pronoun into an inclusive hope rather than a reference to only one detainee.

topics.headline: integrated lexical and structural payoff
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the plural suffix is widened into an inclusive family hope by the following totality word.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows for this word converge on the local grammar, lexical range, structural position, and concrete inter-ayah references preserved in the prose.

words.gloss_range: accusative circumstantial totality: all together as the state of the hoped return
words.root_gloss_range: gathering, collecting, totality, and being all together; locally the collective state of those brought back
words.prose: {{ar:جَمِيعًا}} ({{tr:jamīʿan}}) makes total restoration the state of the hoped bringing. Its accusative circumstantial role ties all-togetherness to the pronoun group, not to Jacob’s act of hoping. The {{ar:ج م ع}} ({{tr:j-m-ʿ}}) pressure turns return into assembly: not scattered arrivals, but the absent group gathered all together, later answered by the family-gathering command in 12:93 and audibly linked to the earlier beautiful-patience word by the j-m sound thread.

topics.headline: integrated lexical and structural payoff
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that Jacob hopes for gathered restoration all together, not eventual scattered returns.

words.gloss_range: emphatic particle plus pronoun shifting from hoped return to asserted divine warrant
words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّهُ}} ({{tr:innahu}}) moves from hope to warrant. The attached pronoun resumes the divine agent from the hope clause, while the emphatic particle shifts from modal expectation to asserted attribute claim. It resumes the divine agent without repeating the name and introduces the final assertion on which the hoped reunion rests.

words.gloss_range: separating emphatic pronoun isolating the divine referent before the paired attributes
words.prose: {{ar:هُوَ}} ({{tr:huwa}}) delays the predicates just enough to make the two divine attributes land as an identity claim. The free pronoun strengthens the closure: the warrant belongs to Him, not to any other agent.

topics.headline: integrated lexical and structural payoff
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the separating pronoun gives the final attributes exclusive identity force.

words.gloss_range: first definite divine attribute in the final seal, grounding hope in comprehensive knowledge
words.root_gloss_range: knowing, teaching, informing, learning, and knowledge; locally the intensive divine Knower, not acquired learning
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْعَلِيمُ}} ({{tr:al-ʿalīmu}}) is the first definite predicate of the closing seal, invoking a recognized divine attribute rather than introducing a new description. The {{ar:ع ل م}} ({{tr:ʿ-l-m}}) range is narrowed to comprehensive divine knowledge: God knows the separated persons and their states, answering Jacob’s later limited-knowledge statement in 12:86 and beginning the formula that frames 12:6, 12:83, and 12:100.

topics.headline: integrated lexical and structural payoff
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that comprehensive divine knowledge is the first explicit warrant for the hoped reunion.

words.gloss_range: second definite divine attribute completing the seal with wise, firm governance
words.root_gloss_range: judging, governing, wisdom, restraining, and making firm; locally divine wisdom ordering the hoped outcome
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْحَكِيمُ}} ({{tr:al-ḥakīmu}}) completes the ayah as a second coordinate definite predicate, not a subordinate afterthought. It pairs knowledge with wise governance. The {{ar:ح ك م}} ({{tr:ḥ-k-m}}) range makes the final word practical: God not only knows the scattered family but governs the timing and manner of reunion fittingly, echoing judgment language in 12:40 and 12:80 and the closing pair in 12:100.

baseline_models.mechanism: The adversative rejects the presented surface and relocates causal manufacture inside the speakers: inward desire or intention adorns a matter until it becomes an acceptable account.

activation_trace.role: Adorning an affair by the self supplies attractive falsification and functions as the account-production operator.
Reason, intention, and what is held inwardly supply the hidden locus and function as the causal agent of the account.
A matter or state supplies the object of adornment and functions as the event-model being diagnosed.

changed_reading.before: The response merely rejects the brothers' report.
changed_reading.after: The response diagnoses how their inward motives manufactured an acceptable version of an affair, shifting attention from a disputed detail to causal self-fashioning.

baseline_models.mechanism: Patience confines the self from panic and premature reaction; beauty qualifies the manner of that restraint, while wise prevention gives it a corrective purpose.

activation_trace.role: Holding the self back from alarm supplies restraint and functions as the brake on reactive judgment.
Beauty in conduct supplies ethical form and functions as the qualifier distinguishing restraint from sullen paralysis.
Prevention for the sake of correction supplies purposeful inhibition and functions as the governing aim of restraint.

changed_reading.before: Beautiful patience is quiet endurance of an unavoidable loss.
changed_reading.after: Beautiful patience is an active ethical restraint that blocks panic and rash judgment while preserving the possibility of corrective action.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: أَن يَأْتِيَنِى بِهِمْ جَمِيعًا ... ٱلْعَلِيمُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
baseline_models.mechanism: The hoped-for arrival reverses dispersal and restores the absent as an intact total; complete knowing and right wisdom warrant that open future despite the speaker's lack of visible means.

activation_trace.role: Coming and arrival supply actual return and function as the motion that ends absence.
Joining what was dispersed supplies reassembly and functions as the reversal of separation.
Wholeness without missing parts supplies intact totality and functions as the no-remainder scope of the hope.
Disclosure to the knower supplies access beyond present evidence and functions as the warrant for hope.
Rightly aimed knowledge supplies wise ordering and functions as the warrant that return need not be accidental.

changed_reading.before: The speaker voices a general wish to see the absent again.
changed_reading.after: The speaker hopes for a divinely ordered reversal of dispersal in which the absent arrive as an intact whole, not as fragments or residue.

context_deltas.mechanism: Hidden reaction, outward description, testimony explicitly limited to what was known, an unguarded unseen, and asserted truth distinguish sincere report from exhaustive knowledge. The closing names therefore govern judgment under an evidence gap rather than merely ornamenting hope.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure to the knower supplies exhaustive cognition and functions as the standard beyond bounded testimony.
Judgment between people supplies adjudication and functions as the disciplined response to conflicting appearances.
Concealment in the interior supplies hidden content and functions as evidence that speech need not expose the whole causal field.
Presenting a thing through its description supplies a verbal representation and functions as the report layer distinct from the thing itself.
Statement grounded in knowledge supplies bounded testimony and functions as the brothers' declared evidentiary limit.
What is hidden from sight supplies the inaccessible remainder and functions as the gap no witness can close.
Truthfulness of speech supplies possible sincerity and functions as a reminder that true reporting can still be causally incomplete.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from concealed content and description in 12:77 to testimony limited by knowledge and the unseen in 12:81, then to proposed corroboration in 12:82.
The focus places ٱلْعَلِيمُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ after both the causal diagnosis and the hope.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hiddenness, representation, bounded testimony, unseen remainder, and claimed truth; I infer that the closing names authorize event-level judgment beyond public evidence. A live alternative is that the names offer general reassurance without defining an evidentiary method.

changed_reading.before: The closing names generally affirm that God knows and acts wisely.
changed_reading.after: The closing names become an epistemic and judicial counterweight: reports may be sincere yet bounded, so the speaker diagnoses a recurrent inward cause without treating the reported event as exhaustive reality.

context_deltas.mechanism: An offered one-for-one replacement and a rule restricting custody to the implicated person establish a piecemeal economy of persons. Against that sequence, جَمِيعًا carries a no-substitute and no-remainder force.

activation_trace.role: Wholeness without loss supplies total scope and functions as the refusal of a remainder.
One as a counting unit supplies the singular substitute and functions as the foil to collective return.
Place or standing supplies the replacement slot and functions as the exchange position offered for occupation.
Seizure and custody supply the taking of a person and function as the fragmenting mechanism the hope must undo.

structural_cues: 12:78 offers one brother in another's place, 12:79 limits taking to one person, and 12:83 asks for them all.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies singular substitution, a replacement place, restricted custody, and total gathering; I infer that total return negates the exchange logic that has divided the family. A live alternative is that جَمِيعًا is only a numerical quantifier with no contrastive force.

changed_reading.before: Integral return means that every absent person eventually arrives.
changed_reading.after: Integral return also rejects substitutionary restoration: no relative is exchanged for another, and no one remains as collateral or residue.

context_deltas.mechanism: The speaker turns away, laments loss, is physically altered by grief, and holds pressure inward; he then explicitly manifests complaint and discloses hidden anguish to God. Beautiful patience regulates audience and direction, not the existence of grief or speech.

activation_trace.role: Holding the self from alarm supplies restraint and functions as control over grief's harmful discharge.
Beauty of conduct supplies ethical quality and functions as the manner in which grief is carried.
Turning away supplies changed audience and functions as separation of grief from confrontation with the sons.
Lament over what has been missed supplies voiced loss and functions as evidence that patience permits mourning.
Grief's roughening of the self supplies real inward injury and functions as the pressure being regulated.
Holding breath and silence supplies inward containment and functions as restraint before a chosen addressee.
Making complaint manifest supplies explicit speech and functions as the permitted Godward channel.
Disclosing what was hidden in the self supplies release and functions as the opposite pole to indiscriminate suppression.

structural_cues: 12:84 moves from turning away to lament, bodily loss, and inward pressure; 12:86 names complaint and hidden anguish as directed exclusively to God.
The focus's nominal فَصَبْرٌ جَمِيلٌ leaves room for an enduring posture rather than a claim of emotional numbness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies separation of audience, lament, pressure, complaint, and Godward disclosure; I infer that patience is selective channel discipline. A live alternative is that lament merely coexists with patience and does not explain its internal mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Beautiful patience means maintaining silence and suppressing grief.
changed_reading.after: Beautiful patience means withholding accusatory or despairing discharge toward the sons while allowing intense lament and full disclosure toward God.

context_deltas.mechanism: The command to track news through perception, joined to a doubled refusal to sever hope and a repeated image of divine relief, turns the hoped-for arrival into a search-governing possibility rather than passive waiting.

activation_trace.role: Holding steady against alarm supplies persistence and functions as the temporal support for continued search.
An approach becoming available supplies practical attainability and functions as the route from hope to action.
Following traces of news supplies active inquiry and functions as the operational form of waiting.
Severance of hope supplies the prohibited terminal inference and functions as the boundary search must not cross.
Relief and rest supply an opening beyond pressure and function as the positive horizon that keeps inquiry alive.

structural_cues: 12:87 orders movement and investigation before twice opposing despair to divine relief.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies continued steadiness, trace-seeking, prohibited despair, and relief; I infer that the hope of arrival licenses practical investigation. A live alternative is that the search is a separate pragmatic command rather than an enactment of the focus's patience.

changed_reading.before: The speaker patiently waits for an arrival only God can cause.
changed_reading.after: Trust in divine arrival sustains active evidence-seeking: present absence is not treated as terminal, so patience generates search instead of inertia.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later ignorance is exposed, then self-protection and patience are explicitly paired with a result that is not lost. Patience thus preserves moral yield across delayed resolution rather than merely reducing immediate distress.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure to the knower supplies the focus's epistemic horizon and functions as the eventual exposure of concealed action.
Holding the self from alarm supplies durable restraint and functions as the behavior preserved through delay.
Absence of knowledge supplies the brothers' disclosed condition and functions as the contrast to the focus's knowing closure.
Placing the self under protection supplies guarded conduct and functions as patience's moral enclosure.
Holding the self from alarm recurs as an explicit condition and functions as confirmation that restraint survives the interval.
Loss and disappearance supply the negated outcome and function as assurance that delayed moral work is preserved.
Recompense for work supplies retained yield and functions as patience's long-horizon result.

structural_cues: 12:89 contrasts retrospective knowledge with prior ignorance; 12:90 explicitly couples protection and patience with a reward that is not lost.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exposed ignorance and a direct protection-patience-no-loss sequence; I infer that the focus's patience preserves action and value through delayed disclosure. A live alternative is that the later maxim applies primarily to Joseph and only analogically illuminates Jacob's earlier posture.

changed_reading.before: Patience prevents a bad reaction during one crisis.
changed_reading.after: Patience is protective preservation across an unresolved interval: it keeps moral action and its eventual yield from being lost before knowledge emerges.

context_deltas.mechanism: Confession of culpable error is followed not by retaliatory blame but by removal of reproach, covering of fault, and mercy. The beauty of patience can therefore be read prospectively as the form that vindication will take when power and knowledge finally arrive.

activation_trace.role: Beauty in action supplies moral form and functions as the criterion for conduct after vindication.
Sin and culpable error supply acknowledged liability and function as the occasion on which retaliation becomes possible.
Blame for wrongdoing supplies reproach and functions as the response explicitly withheld.
Covering fault and protecting its bearer from effects supplies forgiveness and functions as the replacement for recrimination.
Tender mercy supplies compassionate response and functions as the positive completion of withheld blame.

structural_cues: 12:91 acknowledges error; 12:92 immediately answers with no reproach, forgiveness, and mercy.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies culpability followed by non-reproach and mercy; I infer a cross-speaker family parallel in which the earlier patience is beautiful partly because vindication does not mature into revenge. A live alternative is that Joseph's later response should not be used to define Jacob's phrase.

changed_reading.before: Beautiful describes how loss is endured before vindication.
changed_reading.after: Beautiful also describes how vindication is handled afterward: accumulated injury does not become accumulated reproach.

context_deltas.mechanism: A garment is physically cast upon the face, sight returns, and the whole household is commanded to come. The focus's hoped-for gathering becomes an embodied chain of mediation that repairs the perceiver and reassembles the relation, not merely transport of absent bodies.

activation_trace.role: Coming and arrival supply the focus's expected motion and function as the promise later made executable.
Wholeness without missing parts supplies integral scope and functions as the relational target of restoration.
A worn garment supplies the transferred object and functions as the material mediator of restoration.
Casting an object supplies directed placement and functions as the act that links the mediator to the sufferer.
The face and what confronts forward supply the bodily site and function as the interface where absence becomes renewed encounter.
Eyesight supplies restored perception and functions as repair of the one who awaits the return.
Coming and causing arrival recur twice and function as the focus's lexical hope converted into a concrete sequence.
A group bound by nearness and belonging supplies the household and functions as the expanded relational scope of return.
Wholeness without loss recurs as an emphatic total and functions as explicit completion of the focus's gathering.

structural_cues: 12:93 sequences object transfer, contact with the face, return of sight, two forms of coming, household, and emphatic totality.
The focus already joins coming with جَمِيعًا, so the later lexical recurrence supplies a visible realization rather than an independent theme.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the garment-face-sight sequence and then an exact coming-and-totality reprise; I infer that 'all' can activate relational wholeness, including repair of the waiting father, beyond the pronoun's immediate persons. A live alternative is that بِهِمْ remains grammatically limited to the absent sons and that restored sight is only adjacent.

changed_reading.before: God may bring all the absent persons back to the speaker.
changed_reading.after: The return is an embodied reassembly: mediated contact restores the father's capacity to encounter, then the household arrives as a whole.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it links a stopper and a filled, sealed outlet to emotional practice. It remains anchored in صَبْر and the later containment-to-disclosure sequence, but downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy for selective release, not as the lexical meaning of صَبْرٌ جَمِيلٌ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: فَصَبْرٌ جَمِيلٌ, especially صَبْرٌ at word 7

activation_trace.role: A stopper for a bottle or well supplies closure under pressure and functions as the material model for bounded grief.
Sealing an outlet after it fills supplies pressure-filled closure and functions as the model's closed state.
Exposing what was hidden inside supplies release and functions as the selectively opened Godward outlet.

changed_reading.before: Patience seals grief so that it does not emerge.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, beautiful patience behaves like a selective valve: it closes retaliatory discharge toward the sons while opening inward pressure toward God.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus inventory's image is renewed milk after cessation, a pastoral domain distant from human reunion. It remains anchored in عَسَى and is activated by the doubled refusal of despair and repeated relief, but downstream prose should call it an image of latent resumption rather than an etymology or direct gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: عَسَى ٱللَّهُ أَن يَأْتِيَنِى بِهِمْ جَمِيعًا

activation_trace.role: Hope for milk to return after cessation supplies latent yield and functions as a cross-domain image for recoverability after apparent exhaustion.
Severance of hope supplies the terminal reading twice prohibited and functions as the contrast that keeps dormant return live.
Sensory spaciousness and expansion supply reopened capacity and function as the condition under which apparent cessation need not be final.

changed_reading.before: عَسَى expresses uncertain hope despite absence.
changed_reading.after: As an exploratory latent-yield image, apparent cessation is not depletion: return may resume from a source that presently gives no sign of return.

strongest_changes: Beautiful patience becomes selective channeling: restraint toward the sons coexists with severe grief and explicit Godward complaint.
Hope becomes active trace-seeking rather than inert waiting, because present absence is not treated as terminal.
ٱلْعَلِيمُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ becomes an epistemic and judicial response to hidden content, bounded testimony, and incomplete corroboration.
بِهِمْ جَمِيعًا expands into non-substitutionary, embodied household reassembly while retaining the narrower reading of all absent persons.
summary.what_was_special: The sequence preserves several coexisting mechanisms: inward manufacture of an account, disciplined grief, active search, long-horizon moral preservation, nonretaliatory vindication, and material reassembly. The stopper/pressure-release and renewed-yield images remain live but explicitly contained as analogies.
remaining_uncertainties: The immediate grammatical scope of بِهِمْ may remain narrower than the relational household wholeness activated by 12:93.
The protection-patience-no-loss maxim in 12:90 directly concerns a later speaker and may illuminate rather than define the focus posture.
The stopper branch for ص ب ر and renewed-yield branch for ع س ي are productive material images but should not displace their ordinary constructions.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **The earlier diagnostic recurs, but hope expands from one lost son to all.** س و ل B002, ن ف س B013, ص ب ر B001, ج م ل B004, and ج م ع B001 (gathering scattered parts) reactivate 12:18 under a larger dispersion. I infer that beautiful restraint now holds open the possibility of complete regathering.
2. **Knowledge and judgment support hope without specifying its path.** ع ل م B001 and ح ك م B003 make the anticipated gathering intelligible to divine wisdom, not to the father’s available evidence. The ayah reads as disciplined expectation rather than prediction from circumstances.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later 12:90 began the promised gathering with Yusuf and his brother disclosed together; 12:99-100 completed it with parents and household.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **A repeated diagnostic pattern with a changed horizon.** `س و ل:B002` is the self making a matter attractive, especially falsehood or delusion. The exact diagnosis and “beautiful patience” recall 12:18, but this time the father hopes that God will bring *all of them*; 12:84-87 turns grief into complaint to God and an instruction to search, and 12:88 reaches Joseph again. The packet supplies repetition plus altered action; I infer that recognizing the old self-justifying pattern no longer confines him to passive endurance. The ayah reads as memory-informed suspicion joined to enlarged hope.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later 12:91 supplies the brothers' confession that divine preference had indeed exceeded their judgment, while reunion changes the consequence; the father's diagnosis is confirmed without becoming a sentence of permanent estrangement.

facets.statement: Bir varlığın sayı, miktar veya ölçü bakımından çok olmayışıdır.

Bir şeyi gerçekte ya da değerlendiren kişinin gözünde az sayma ve az gösterme anlamını taşır.
Belirli olumsuzluk ve sıklık yapılarında hiç yokluğu veya bir eylemin pek seyrek gerçekleşmesini anlatır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir şeyin en üstünü veya başını çekirdek anlam olarak verir; dağın yuvarlak üst bölümü, insan başı ve kılıcın başındaki topuz bu çekirdeğin açık uzmanlaşmalarıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Genel baş ve en üst bölüm anlamı ile dağ tepesi, insan başı ve kılıç topuzu gibi yapıya bağlı uzmanlaşmalar ayrı tutulur.

İnsan başı ile kılıcın sap ucundaki başlık veya topuz da aynı üst ve baş kavramıyla adlandırılır.

facets.statement: Küpe benzeyen, özellikle sıvı taşımaya veya saklamaya elverişli büyük bir kaptır.
Belirli bir bölgeyle anılan iri küpler veya büyük toprak kaplar bu adın tanınmış bir türünü oluşturur.
İki büyük kap, bu iki kabın kendisini veya onların aldığı sıvı miktarını bildiren bir ölçü değeri kazanır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yükü taşıma veya taşıyabilme ile öznenin yükselip harekete geçmesini aynı kolda açıkça toplar; kuşun uçuşa kalkması, göğün yükselmesi ve yolcuların yüklenip ayrılması ayrı katılımcı gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Bir nesneyi kaldıracak gücü bulmak, onu taşımak veya yük olarak üstlenmektir.
Bir öznenin aşağıdaki konumundan yükselmesi veya kuş gibi harekete ve uçuşa başlamasıdır.
Yolcuların yüklerini alıp bulundukları yerden ayrılarak yolculuğa başlamasıdır.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kol insanda korku veya öfkeyle beliren titremeyle sınırlıdır; nesnelerin genel sallanma ve yerinde duramama hali ayrı koldadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Duygudan doğan titreme temel addır; kişiyi titremenin tutması ve öfkeden titrer hale gelmesi yalnızca ilgili yapılara bağlı anlatımlardır.

concept_map.definition: Bir insanın korku veya öfke yüzünden titremesi, ürpermesi ya da bedensel olarak silkelenmesidir. Durum, kişiyi bir titreme nöbetinin tutması veya öfkenin titremeyle dışa vurulması biçiminde anlatılabilir.

facets.statement: İnsan bedeninde beliren titreme, ürperti veya istemsiz silkiniş halidir.
Titremenin belirleyici nedeni korku ya da öfkedir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar insandaki titreme ve silkinişte birleşir; korku ile öfke başlıca nedenlerdir ve durum hem kişiyi tutan bir nöbet hem öfkenin bedensel belirtisi olarak anlatılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir şeyi hareket ettirip sallandırma, nesnenin bulunduğu yerde kararlı duramaması ve hareketin çıkardığı sesi birlikte verir; bunlar tek bir fiziksel hareket olayının neden, sonuç ve işitsel yönleridir.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi hareket ettirerek yerinden oynatmayı ve onun kararsızca sallanıp bulunduğu yerde duramamasını bildirir; bu hareketin çıkardığı ses de aynı olayın işitsel yönüdür.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü, bir şeydeki gevşemeyi temel anlam sayar ve insan, bitki ile bulutun özellikle alt bölümündeki gevşek ya da sarkık görünüşü bu temelin gerçekleşmeleri olarak verir. Sunulan dal çerçevesi bu çekirdeği ve örneklenen alt bölüm özelliğini doğru biçimde korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal yalnızca aşağı doğru uzamayı ya da eğilmeyi değil, gerginliğin azalmasıyla oluşan gevşeklik ve sarkmayı anlatır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal çıplak anlamı tanımlar; herhangi bir söz kalıbına özgü anlamı bu genel gevşeme ve sarkma alanına katmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin gerginliğini yitirerek gevşemesi ve kimi gerçekleşmelerde alt bölümünün aşağı sarkmasıdır. İnsan bedeninin göbek altı, bitkinin altı ve bulutun alt bölümü ya da saçağı bu durumla nitelenebilir.

facets.statement: Temel durum, bir şeyde gerginliğin azalması ve gevşeklik oluşmasıdır.
Gevşeklik, insanın, bitkinin ya da bulutun alt bölümünde aşağı sarkma görünümü kazanabilir.
Göbek altındaki karın bölümünün gevşek olması, beden üzerindeki belirgin örnektir.
Bulutun altının gevşek görünmesi ve saçaklarının aşağı salınması, buluta özgü gerçekleşmedir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çekirdeği bir şeydeki gevşemedir. İnsan, bitki ve bulut örneklerinde bu gevşeme özellikle alt bölümün sarkmasıyla görünür; karında göbek altı, bulutta ise aşağı salınan saçaklar ayrıca belirtilir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Gerginliğin azalması çekirdeğini ve insan, bitki ya da bulutun alt bölümünde görülebilen sarkmayı birlikte karşılayan genel anlatımdır.

error_profile.preserves: Hem gevşeme durumunu hem de bunun alt bölümde aşağı sarkma olarak belirebilmesini korur.

error_profile.loses: Genel gevşeme çekirdeğini ve insan bedenindeki özel gerçekleşmeyi tek başına karşılamaz.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dalı çekici gösterilen işin benimsenmesi ya da kötülüğün gerçekleşmesi sonucunu gerektirmez.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal aldatıp umutlandırarak kişiyi kötülüğe düşürme ya da onu buna yüreklendirme sonucunu öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da alıcıya yanıltıcı bir çekicilik sunulabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalının sınırı işi çekici gösterme aşamasında biter; komşu dal bu sunuşun kişiyi kötülüğe düşürme veya yüreklendirme etkisini kurucu sayar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dalı bir şeyi güzel göstererek sunma yolunu belirler.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal yoldan çıkarma ve bozma sonucunu, bunun hangi sunuş yoluyla yapıldığına bağlı olmadan anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Çekici gösterilen yanlış bir iş, kişiyi yoldan çıkarma ve bozma sürecine katılabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalı görünüşü değiştiren sunuma, komşu dal ise kişi üzerindeki bozucu sonuca dayanır. Çekici gösterme olmadan da bozma gerçekleşebilir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; çekici gösterme işlemini süslü sözden, saptırmadan, kötülüğe düşürmeden ve bozmadan ayıran dört doğrudan karşıtlık yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه سولت النفس أو الشيطان الأمر: زينته وأرته لصاحبه، وخاصة تزيين الباطل والغرور.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه الاسترخاء الحسي، ولا السؤل نفسه بوصفه حاجة أو أمنية قبل تزيينها.
branches.source_phrase_ar: سولت له الشيء إذا زينته له (maqayis)؛ سولت لفلان نفسه أمرا وسول له الشيطان أي زين وأراه إياه (ayn)؛ سولت له نفسه أمرا أي زينته له (sihah)؛ سولت لكم أنفسكم أمرا، أي زينت لكم أنفسكم أمرا غير ما تصفون، وكأن التسويل تفعيل من سول الإنسان وهو أمنيته (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü, kişinin gönlünün yöneldiği gereksinimi, elde etmeyi dilediği şeyi ve istediğinde kendisine verilen dileği aynı anlam alanında toplar. Sunulan dal, istenen şeyi isteme eylemiyle karıştırmadan bu nesne ve dilek çekirdeğini doğru yansıtır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, isteme sözünün kendisini ya da sorulan bir soruyu değil, gönülden istenen gereksinimi, dileği veya elde edilmek istenen şeyi anlatır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal çıplak anlamı tanımlar; belirli bir söz kuruluşuna bağlı olmayan istenen gereksinim, dilek veya istenen şey çekirdeğini korur.

concept_map.definition: Kişinin gönülden elde etmek istediği bir gereksinim, dilek ya da istenen şeydir. İsteme eyleminden çok, o eylemin yöneldiği ve kişinin içten bağlı olduğu içeriği bildirir.

facets.statement: Çekirdek, kişinin gönlünün güçlü biçimde yöneldiği gereksinim ya da istenen şeydir.
İstenen içerik, kişinin elde etmeyi dilediği ve isteme yoluyla yöneldiği bir dilek olabilir.
Aynı istenen şey anlamı, bir sesteki hafifletmeyle oluşan ikinci söyleyiş biçiminde de aktarılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, kişinin gönülden istediği gereksinim veya dilek ile isteme eyleminin yöneldiği şey üzerinde birleşir. Bir sesteki hafifletmeyle söylenen biçim de aynı istenen şey anlamını taşır.

error_profile.preserves: Gönülden yönelme, gereksinim, dilek ve istenen şey bileşenlerini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İstenen içeriğin bir dilek olarak öne çıktığı bağlamlarda doğal ve kısa bir karşılıktır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kişinin güçlü biçimde yöneldiği içeriğin bir gereksinim olduğu bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: İstenen içerik ile kişinin ona güçlü yönelişini korur.
error_profile.loses: Gereksinim olmayan bir dilek veya istenen şey kapsamını dışarıda bırakır.

error_profile.collision: Bilgi isteyen soru ve sorma eylemi alanıyla karışır.

error_profile.preserves: Kişinin bir şeye yönelmesini ve onu dilemesini korur.
error_profile.adds: İstenen nesneden ayrı olarak isteme eğilimini, eylemini veya bildirilen buyruğu da kapsama ekler.
error_profile.collision: İsteme durumu ve bir başkasına yöneltilen istem alanlarıyla karışabilir.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal istenen şeyi, onu bir başkasından isteme ve istenmiş olma yönüyle daha belirgin biçimde sınırlar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da kişinin elde etmek istediği gereksinimi ya da istenen şeyi adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalında gönülden yönelinen dilek ve gereksinim belirgindir; komşuda bir istemin yöneldiği şey olma sınırı daha baskındır. Bu vurgu ayrılığı tam eş anlamlılığı engeller.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dalı bir gereksinimi ve bir başkasından istenen şeyi de kapsayabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, gönlün zihinde tasarladığı ve gerçekleşmesini dilediği görüntüyü öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da kişinin gönülden elde etmeyi istediği bir dileği anlatabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal dileğin gönülde tasarlanmasına dayanır; odak dalı ise tasarlanmış bir görüntü gerektirmeden gereksinimi veya istenen şeyi de kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dalı isteğin yöneldiği gereksinimi, dileği ya da istenen şeyi adlandırır.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Kişi bir şeyi gönülden istediğinde hem bir dilek içeriği hem de dileme durumu bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalı istenen içeriğe, komşu dal ise o içeriğin gerçekleşmesini dileme durumuna merkezlenir. Nesne ile yöneliş durumu birbirinin yerine geçmez.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dalı elde edilmek istenen içeriği bildirir ve yinelemeli arama gerektirmez.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal bir şeyi arama, isteme ve ona tekrar tekrar yönelme sürecini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İstenen bir şeye yönelme, hem istenen içerikle hem de onu elde etme çabasıyla ilişkilidir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalı yönelinen gereksinim veya dilektir; komşu dal ise bu şeye yönelik arama ve isteme sürecidir. Sonuç nesnesi ile süreç aynı değildir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, akciğerli bir canlının gövdesine havanın girip çıkmasını ve bu döngünün tek tek sayılabilmesini doğrudan anlatır. İçme sırasında sayılan soluklar da bu bedensel sürecin özel bir bağlamıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam, canlı solunumuyla sınırlıdır; can, kan, öz varlık ya da sıkıntı giderme anlamlarını içermez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak dal, soluk alıp verme sürecini bildirir; içme bağlamı yalnızca bu sürecin sayıldığı bir kullanımdır.

concept_map.definition: Akciğerli bir canlının havayı ağız ya da burun yoluyla gövdesine alıp yeniden dışarı vermesidir. Her bir giriş-çıkış döngüsü ayrı bir soluk olarak sayılabilir.

facets.statement: Havanın ağız ya da burun yoluyla gövdeye girip yeniden çıkmasıdır.
İçme sırasında verilen her ara soluk, aynı solunum döngüsünün sayılan bir örneğidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, temel anlamı havanın canlı gövdesine girip çıkması ve bu hareketin tekil döngüler hâlinde sayılması olarak ortaklaştırır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Canlının havayı içine alıp dışarı verdiği temel bedensel süreç için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Havanın gövdeye girişini ve yeniden çıkışını birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Solunumun ya da içme sırasında verilen aranın tek bir döngü olarak sayıldığı yerde uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Tek bir giriş-çıkış döngüsünün sayılabilirliğini korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: tek soluk ya da soluklanma arası

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, sessiz ve olağan hava girişini de kapsayan tam solunum döngüsüdür.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, göğüsten havayı dışarı vermeye, buna eşlik eden sese ve sıkıntı belirtisine ağırlık verir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da gövdedeki havanın dışarı çıkması bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal hava alma ile vermeyi birlikte içeren genel solunumdur; komşu ise özellikle güçlü dışa verişi ve doğan sesi anlatır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün aday kartlar karşılaştırıldı; soluk verme odağındaki bu komşu, temel sınırı en açık biçimde gösterdiği için seçildi.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, sıkıntı içindeki kişinin yükünü hafifletme ve ona ferahlık sağlama eylemini açıkça kurar. Esinti ya da yardım da ancak bu rahatlatıcı işlev bakımından dala girer.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, önceden var olan bir sıkıntının giderilmesini gerektirir; genel genişlik, süre ya da bedensel solunum değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Eylem kalıpları sıkıntıyı giderme işini, ayrı bir kullanım ise esinti ya da yardımı bu işin aracı olarak anlatır.

concept_map.definition: Sıkıntı içindeki birinin üzerindeki baskıyı azaltıp ona rahatlama sağlamaktır. Esinti ya da yardım, bu rahatlamayı sağladığı ölçüde aynı anlam alanına girer.

facets.statement: Sıkıntı içindeki kişinin yükünü hafifletip onu rahatlatma eylemidir.
Esinti veya yardım, sıkıntıdakine ferahlık getiren araç olarak adlandırılabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, sıkıntının hafifletilmesi ile bunun sağladığı ferahlığı ortak çekirdek sayar; esinti ve yardım bu işlevle ilişkilendirilir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir kişinin içinde bulunduğu darlık ya da ağır durum etkin biçimde azaltıldığında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Önceki sıkıntıyı, yükün azaltılmasını ve ortaya çıkan rahatlamayı korur.

contextual_glosses.text: ferahlık getiren esinti ya da yardım
contextual_glosses.applicability: Esinti veya yardım, sıkıntıdaki kişiyi rahatlatan araç olarak anıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Aracın sıkıntıyı gideren işlevini açıkça korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: Tanrı'nın sıkıntıdakilere ferahlık getiren esintisi ya da yardımı

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak, bir sıkıntıyı giderip kişiye ferahlık verme eylemidir; komşu, bu etkinin sonucu olan çözülme ve kurtulma durumuna daha çok ağırlık verir.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه نفس الله الكربة، والتنفس عن المكروب، والفرج من الشدة، والريح أو الأنصار حين تذكر باعتبار التفريج.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس هو مجرد النفس الهوائي ولا مطلق السعة أو المهلة بلا كربة.
branches.source_phrase_ar: نفس الله كربته والنفس كل شيء يفرج به عن مكروب (maqayis); نفست عنه تنفيسا أي رفهت (sihah); اللهم نفس عني أي فرج عني والريح من نفس الرحمن (tahdhib;mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir bakışın kişiye zarar verdiği inancını, bu zararın gerçekleşmesini ve zararlı bakışı yönelten kişiyi aynı dalda açıkça birleştirir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Buradaki göz, görme organı ya da özdeşlik bildiren göz değil, zarar verdiğine inanılan bakıştır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak biçimler zararlı bakışı ve bunu yönelten kişiyi, kalıp kullanım ise bakışın birine değmesini anlatır.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişinin bakışıyla başkasına zarar verdiğine inanılan etki ve bu etkinin birine ulaşmasıdır. Bu bakışı yönelten kişi de dalın adlandırma alanındadır.

facets.statement: Zarar verdiğine inanılan bakışın bir kişiye yönelip onu etkilemesidir.
Zararlı bakışı yönelten kişi, bu etkiyi yapan kimse olarak adlandırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, zarar veren bakış, bu bakışın birine değmesi ve onu yönelten kişi arasında ortak ve tutarlı bir anlam bağı kurar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir bakışın kişiye zarar getirdiğine inanılan etkiyi ve gerçekleşmesini anlatır.

error_profile.preserves: Zararlı bakışı, yönelten kişiyi ve etkilenen kişiyi birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Zararlı olduğuna inanılan bakışın bir kişiyi etkilediği cümlelerde doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Bakışın hedefe ulaşıp zarar vermesi olayını korur.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bakışla zarar verme, bunu yapan kişi ve bundan etkilenen kişi sınırlarını paylaşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Verilen kartlarda çekirdek, katılımcılar ve kapsam bakımından anlamlı bir ayrım görünmez; iki dal birbirinin yerine geçebilir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün aday kartlar gözden geçirildi; yalnızca sınırları tam örtüşen eş anlamlı dal yayımlanmaya değer bulundu.
